sloka: विमुक्तौ शरबन्धेन तौ दृश्येते रणाजिरे ।पाशानिव गजौ छित्त्वा गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ ।। ६.५१.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: vimuktau śarabandhena tau dṛśyete raṇājire ।pāśāniva gajau chittvā gajendrasamavikramau ।। 6.51.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."
translations.hindi: जाम्बवान की बात सुन और विभीषण को देख, समस्त वानरों का भ्रम दूर हो गया और वे लौट आए
